# Dortch Lindstrom Livingston Law Group

> > A Texas-based civil litigation firm specializing in personal injury, commercial litigation, and wrongful death claims with nationwide representation.

Dortch Lindstrom Livingston Law Group (DLL) is a full-service litigation law firm focused on personal injury and commercial litigation across Texas and nationwide. The firm handles vehicle accidents, catastrophic injuries, medical malpractice, workplace accidents, and specialized claims including oilfield injuries and sexual assault cases.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Civil Litigation
- Motor Vehicle Accidents
- Medical Malpractice
- Wrongful Death
- Negligence Claims
- Damages Recovery
- Settlement Negotiation
- Texas Law
- Catastrophic Injuries
- Insurance Claims
- Commercial Litigation
- Legal Representation
- Trucking Regulations
- Premises Liability
